description: Use this when the user asks which ETFs would diversify an ETF or a portfolio of ETFs, what could be added to diversify it, or which ETFs moved least with what they hold. Ranks a fixed, published list of 30 large US ETFs across six kinds of exposure (US, sector, international and emerging market stocks, bonds and commodities) by the correlation of their weekly returns with the portfolio's over up to three years, and returns the ETF of lowest correlation in each of the three groups whose lowest is lowest, with its correlation on the weeks the portfolio fell, the portfolio's volatility with 10% in it and its overlap by weight, then the next ETFs of the list. Takes 1 to 6 ETFs held. A measurement of past co-movement, not investment advice; every answer carries that note. Not for the overlap of ETFs the user names (compare_etfs, get_etf_overlap_matrix) or the risk of the portfolio itself (get_etf_portfolio_risk).

positions.description: The ETFs held, 1 to 6, for example [{"ticker": "VOO", "amount": 60000}, {"ticker": "QQQ", "amount": 20000}]. Give an amount for every position or for none; with none, every ETF counts equally.

amount.description: What this position is worth, in the same unit on every line.

ticker.description: A US ETF ticker, for example VOO or SCHD. Case does not matter.

name: find_diversifying_etfs
title: ETFs that diversify a portfolio
